issues.title: Mobile HUD clips the bottom action row on short screens
issues.body:
## Summary
The play screen action row can clip on short mobile viewports.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The action row remains visible on mobile Safari.
- No controls overlap the puzzle board.
- Existing desktop layout remains unchanged.

issues.title: Add keyboard shortcut help to the pause menu
issues.body:
## Summary
Players should be able to discover keyboard shortcuts from inside the pause menu.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Shortcut help is visible from the pause menu.
- Copy is concise and matches the current control scheme.
